title: Network Security
shortDescription: Protect networks, endpoints and critical infrastructure from unauthorized access.
fullDescription: Defend distributed networks with deep layer-7 packet inspection, TLS 1.3 cryptographic verification, and microsegmented zero-trust security perimeters. SPECTRE DEFEND insulates on-premise hardware, SD-WAN fabrics, and hybrid cloud backbones against lateral intrusion, automated credential stuffing, and high-volume volumetric DDoS assaults.
features: Deep Packet Wire-Speed TLS 1.3 Cryptographic Inspection
Next-Gen AI Firewall Integration & Protocol Sanitization
seoTitle: Enterprise Network Security & Microsegmentation | SPECTRE DEFEND
seoDescription: Hardened network security with line-rate packet inspection, autonomous zero-trust microsegmentation, and DDoS suppression.
whatIs: SPECTRE DEFEND Network Security is a comprehensive infrastructure defense fabric providing wire-speed line-rate packet inspection, zero-trust network access (ZTNA), dynamic microsegmentation, and terabit-scale distributed DDoS suppression.
howItWorks:
1. Ingress & Egress Wire Inspection: Traffic passes through cryptographic filtering gates verifying protocol validity.
2. Microsegmentation Policies: Internal endpoints are partitioned into cryptographically isolated micro-zones.
3. Continuous Traffic Profiling: AI anomaly detectors identify port scanning, C2 beaconing, and unauthorized data exfiltration.
4. Automated Route Shunting: Malicious IP ranges and volumetric surges are shunted across global anycast scrubber nodes.
whyItMatters: Flat enterprise networks enable threat actors to move laterally across workstations, servers, and sensitive storage systems after a single workstation breach. SPECTRE DEFEND eliminates lateral movement pathways completely.
whoItIsFor: Distributed multi-office enterprises, data centers, hybrid cloud deployments, and organizations operating PCI-DSS or HIPAA compliant environments requiring strict subnet segregation.
deliverables: Terabit DDoS Mitigation Service Level Agreement

faqs.question: Will deep packet inspection introduce latency to our network?
faqs.answer: No. SPECTRE DEFEND uses hardware-accelerated eBPF datapaths and custom silicon offloading that processes full TLS 1.3 decryptions with sub-microsecond overhead, maintaining 99.999% network uptime.

faqs.question: Can SPECTRE DEFEND integrate with existing SD-WAN and MPLS providers?
faqs.answer: Yes. SPECTRE DEFEND natively integrates with Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, AWS DirectConnect, and Azure ExpressRoute architectures.
